criteria.label: Task and design-intent fit
checks: Primary job, user role and assistance mode are explicit
Capability and action boundaries are represented
The selected pattern is not chat-first by default

criteria.label: Human control and action visibility
checks: High-impact actions show target, scope and effect before confirmation
Confirm, reject, cancel and takeover actions are distinct
Controls correspond to real product behavior or are explicitly disabled

criteria.label: State integrity
checks: Applicable states are represented or have a recorded exemption
Partial, completed and verified meanings are distinct
Waiting and failure states name the next required action

criteria.label: Clarity, sources and unknowns
checks: Source, evidence and unknown-state affordances are visible when applicable
Completion is not presented as independent verification
Operational rationale is concise and private chain-of-thought is not exposed or simulated

criteria.label: Recovery and collaboration
checks: Failures offer a real retry, edit, undo, reopen or takeover path
The interface shows whose turn or input is required
Long-running work is interruptible when supported

criteria.label: Action history and change traceability
checks: Consequential actions have visible operational history
AI changes to user-owned content can show a diff
Timestamps, versions and source links carry real state

criteria.label: Layout and typography
checks: Dense information remains readable
Chinese labels do not overflow or collide
Task-appropriate hierarchy and the selected project visual system are applied

criteria.label: Desktop and accessibility behavior
checks: Declared desktop window sizes remain usable
State meaning does not rely on color alone
Keyboard focus, live-region and reduced-motion behavior are covered

criteria.label: Rendered evidence boundary
checks: Reviewed states and viewports are named
Rendered, live-behavior and human-acceptance evidence are reported separately
A static score is not presented as live runtime acceptance

ratings.pass: The AI App UI design profile is ready or close to ready for the next applicable review boundary.
ratings.review: The direction is usable, but control, state, evidence, recovery or rendered proof needs repair.
ratings.fail: Do not treat the AI App UI design as ready until the failed contract is repaired.
